name: evora-donuts
description: Aplikasi operasional bisnis donat multi-cabang (kasir, distribusi, gudang, gaji, pesanan, shift kas).

scripts.build: npm run minify && npm run gzip
scripts.gzip: gzip -c app.bundle.min.js > app.bundle.min.js.gz || echo 'gzip not available'
scripts.analyze: npx source-map-explorer app.bundle.js || echo 'Install source-map-explorer first'
